_note: Fictional MCA offer from a fictional funder.
pitch: Get $40,000 in 24 hours. Simple 1.35 factor - no interest, no APR, no hassle!

clauses.title: Purchase price
clauses.text: Funder purchases $54,000.00 of Merchant's future receivables (the 'Purchased Amount') for $40,000.00 (the 'Purchase Price'), a factor of 1.35.

clauses.title: Origination & underwriting fee
clauses.text: An origination and underwriting fee of $1,200.00 shall be deducted from the Purchase Price at funding.

clauses.title: Daily remittance
clauses.text: Merchant authorizes Funder to debit a fixed daily amount of $197.26 by ACH, representing 6% of estimated daily receivables. Funder is not obligated to adjust the daily amount.

clauses.title: Early payoff
clauses.text: The full Purchased Amount is owed regardless of the date of delivery. No discount is provided for early payment.

clauses.title: Confession of judgment
clauses.text: Merchant and Guarantor irrevocably authorize entry of judgment against them for the unpaid Purchased Amount plus 25% attorney fees, without notice or hearing.

clauses.title: Security interest
clauses.text: Merchant grants Funder a security interest in all present and future accounts, inventory, equipment and proceeds, and agrees not to obtain any other financing while any amount remains owed.
